comment: Edge cases of the critical algorithms of framework/. Each case names the ctest tests that prove it, as regular expressions matched against the whole ctest name. A case with no test is a known gap. Checked by tools/intern/check-edge-cases.py against the last ctest run.

cases.case: events of one lane leave in posting order
a higher priority lane is drained first
exit pre-empts every queued event
a drained exit delivers what is queued and refuses new events
the consumer posting to its own full ring fails at once
another thread posting to a full ring waits for the consumer
an exit releases a producer blocked on a full ring
no wakeup is lost between the check and the wait
many producers lose no event
a header cut in the middle is completed by the next read
a body cut in the middle is completed by the next read
a message longer than the limit closes the connection
an unknown message type is refused
bytes cached for a closed socket never reach the next client on the same descriptor
a client that reads slowly is held, not dropped
a stop while the router is flooded ends cleanly
a size that wraps around is refused
a truncated nested buffer keeps the destination and the cursor
a view refuses every write
a failed allocation leaves the buffer as it was
an envelope without a block takes no data
a busy request is refused without replacing the waiting caller
a session is consumed once and restorable out of order
session IDs skip the invalid ID and open sessions after a wrap
a response with no waiting request is dropped
a request through a proxy not connected yet fails at once
a request to a provider that is gone fails
a request to a stub not started is answered undelivered
a disconnected caller keeps the request busy until it is answered
the router rejecting the client disconnects the channel and the client retries
the router disconnect notice loses the channel and the client connects again
a start asked twice makes one connection
a request before the router confirmed the connection fails and is not sent
a refused send reconnects and the next request carries the new cookie
the first messages of many producers are all accepted while the send thread starts
a connect notice with a failed result loses the connection
a duplicate public role name is refused
two public role names with one number are told apart
a held provider is taken over, cancelled or disconnected
a truncated registration is refused
registrations from one source are kept apart
a stop of the router with registered clients ends cleanly
a hung thread with policy Exit ends the process
a hung thread with policy Restart is replaced
a hung thread with policy Ignore is abandoned
at most two hung instances of a thread
a component hung in its startup or shutdown
two threads unload the same model at the same time
a component unloads its own model
a component that cannot be created fails the load
a thread name taken by a running thread fails the load
the start of a component thread fails
a periodic timer fires every period
release cancels an armed timer before its dispatcher is destroyed
a timer forked into a child process
a failed lock is reported, and is fatal when asked
a timer does not end other waits of its thread
an object initialised by two threads at once
a paused source keeps its count of dropped rows
logs written before the start are counted and reported when the queue cannot hold them
a full database writer drops rows and reports them
a scope update without a known priority is refused
a truncated log message is dropped by the observer
every nothrow allocation of a model load and unload may fail without a crash
every nothrow allocation of the IPC client may fail without a crash
